description:
COACTUPC REENTER with a blank account id - the positive half of the entry-versus-re-entry contract (gate G38) and the one case in this folder that owns the error highlight. It is the literal continuation of case01: case01 ends by SETting CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:970 and returning that commarea, so the sixteen navigation fields declared in screenRequest.commarea here are, field for field, the sixteen case01 leaves in expectedResponse.navigation, and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is the 1 the 88 at app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:31 names CDEMO-PGM-REENTER. The operator pressed ENTER on that screen without typing an account number. EIBCALEN is 1033 - CARDDEMO-COMMAREA's 160 bytes followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA's 873, the only non-zero full-carry length this program's area can have - so the FIRST disjunct of the commarea gate at :880 is false, and the second at :881-882 is false too because it requires NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and the context is REENTER. The ELSE at :887-892 therefore runs and unpacks DFHCOMMAREA(1:LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and the remainder into WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, which is the branch case01 does not take. ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION arrives in its ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED state and is deliberately NOT declared in screenRequest.commarea: ParityCase's inbound pattern admits a CDEMO- or WS- prefixed item and ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION is neither, and it does not need declaring because :654-658 gives the field VALUE LOW-VALUES and the 88 at :656-658 is VALUES LOW-VALUES, SPACES - the state is the copybook's own default. EIBAID is DFHENTER, so YYYY-STORE-PFKEY at :898-899 yields CCARD-AID-ENTER and the validity gate at :904-916 accepts it as PFK-VALID without the :914-916 remap. THE ORDER-SENSITIVE EVALUATE TRUE at :921 lands on WHEN OTHER, and which arm it lands on is the whole reason this case differs from case01: :927 CCARD-AID-PFK03 is false; :964-965 requires ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED AND CDEMO-PGM-ENTER and the context is REENTER, so it fails on the second conjunct alone - this is the arm case01 took; :966-967 requires CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM EQUAL LIT-MENUPGM AND NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and fails on both; :979-980 ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE / ACUP-CHANGES-FAILED are false against a LOW-VALUES change action. So :996-1003 performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP and leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN - the full input path, which case01 never enters. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP :1039-1062: the RECEIVE MAP('CACTUPA') MAPSET('COACTUP ') INTO(CACTUPAI) at :1040-1045, INITIALIZE ACUP-NEW-DETAILS at :1047, then the account-id test at :1051-1058 - ACCTSIDI is SPACES, so the IF is true and LOW-VALUES goes to CC-ACCT-ID and ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID-X rather than the received characters. Then :1060-1062 IF ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED GO TO 1100-RECEIVE-MAP-EXIT, and that early exit is why screenRequest.mapFields declares ACCTSIDI and nothing else: none of the other fifty-three xxxI items is received at all on this path, and the five COMPUTE sites at :1079, :1093, :1107, :1121 and :1135 - every piece of arithmetic in the program - are never reached. Declaring the other fifty-three would assert that they were read. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS :1429-1449: SET INPUT-OK at :1431, then :1433 is true so :1435-1436 performs 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT through the benign range PERFORM, :1438 MOVEs LOW-VALUES to ACUP-OLD-ACCT-DATA, :1441-1443 flags the blank filter and :1446 leaves. 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT :1783-1797 in order: :1784 SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK - which matters, because it is immediately superseded; :1787-1788 CC-ACCT-ID EQUAL LOW-VALUES is true; :1789 SET INPUT-ERROR; :1790 SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK, and since the 88s at :184-186 are ISVALID '1', NOT-OK '0' and BLANK ' ', WS-EDIT-ACCT-FLAG now holds a space, so FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true and FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is FALSE; :1791-1793 WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF is true, so WS-PROMPT-FOR-ACCT is set - the byte-exact 27-character literal 'Account number not provided' at :483-484; :1794-1795 MOVE ZEROES TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID and ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID, both numeric receivers; :1796 GO TO 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT, so the not-numeric arm at :1799-1817 is not reached. THE MESSAGE THAT SURVIVES IS THE SECOND ONE, AND THIS CASE PINS THAT RATHER THAN THE READING THAT MAKES MORE SENSE. Back at :1441-1443, IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK SET NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED TO TRUE. NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED is a second 88-level on the very same WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) field at :489-490, and unlike :1791 the SET is NOT guarded by IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF - the field is no longer off, it holds the prompt. SETting an 88 assigns its literal, so 'Account number not provided' is overwritten and the value that reaches COMMON-RETURN is the 17-character 'No input received'. Two messages are produced in sequence and only one is observable, because they are one field; that is why expectedMessages carries exactly one entry and not two. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION :2562-2641 is the second place a plausible reading diverges. WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :2568 has NO statement of its own: it shares the body of the WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 arm at :2572, which is IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID / SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF / PERFORM 9000-READ-ACCT / IF FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER SET ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :2573-2580. The filter is BLANK, not ISVALID, so that entire block is a no-op - which is exactly why nothing is read, why expectedWrites is empty, and above all why the message is still 'No input received' when the screen is composed: had the filter been valid, :2574 would have cleared it. 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG :2955-2982 takes its second arm - :2958 CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is false and :2960-2961 ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is true - and SETs PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS, the 39-character literal at :468-469 held in WS-INFO-MSG PIC X(40); :2979 MOVEs it into INFOMSGO PIC X(45), right-space-padded to 45, and :2981 MOVEs WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), right-space-padded to 78. So the information line is byte-identical to case01's and the error line is the one thing on the screen that differs by text. GATE G38 - THE HIGHLIGHT, AND A CORRECTION WORTH RECORDING. The account filter's highlight is NOT one of the thirty-nine COPY CSSETATY expansions at :3208-3436. It is hand-written at :3170-3184, and the three IFs there are not equivalent to the copybook. :3171-3173 restores DFHDFCOL when CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET equals LIT-CCLISTMAPSET - the seven-character 'COCRDLI' at :553-554 - and does not fire here because CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET arrives as seven spaces. :3176-3178 moves DFHRED when FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and, unlike every CSSETATY site, carries NO REENTER guard; it does not fire here either, because :1790 left the flag on BLANK and not NOT-OK. :3180-3184 is the one that fires: IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, MOVE '*' TO ACCTSIDO OF CACTUPAO and MOVE DFHRED TO ACCTSIDC OF CACTUPAO. Both halves of the rule are asserted here and both are guarded by REENTER, which is what makes case01 - identical in every other respect and ENTER rather than REENTER - the negative control that proves the guard is real. The asterisk is a one-character literal moved into PIC X(11), so COBOL pads the alphanumeric receiver on the right and ACCTSIDO is an asterisk followed by ten spaces, not an asterisk followed by ten LOW-VALUES; it overwrites the LOW-VALUES that 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS :2707 had already moved there from CC-ACCT-ID. DFHRED is 0xF2 in common.BmsAttributes, reproduced from IBM CICS documentation because DFHBMSCA is IBM-supplied and absent from this repository (risk R-D), and it is declared here by mnemonic rather than by raw byte so the expectation states what the program moved. THEN :3186-3192 ENDS THE PARAGRAPH EARLY: IF ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED OR FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK OR FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK, GO TO 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS-EXIT. All three disjuncts are true, so the thirty-nine CSSETATY expansions never run and no other field can be red however the flags stand - which is why every other one of the fifty-four colour items is DFHDFCOL. THE REST OF THE SCREEN, rule by rule. 3100-SCREEN-INIT :2669 MOVEs LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO, so each xxxO item starts as x'00' at the width its xxxI item declares in app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, rendered here as literal U+0000 characters one per byte because FieldDiffer compares bytes; :2673-2690 then assigns the same six header items case01 pins - TITLE01O and TITLE02O from CCDA-TITLE01 and the ACTIVE CCDA-TITLE02 at app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-19 and :22, TRNNAMEO from LIT-THISTRANID and PGMNAMEO from LIT-THISPGM at :533-536, and CURDATEO with CURTIMEO from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE. 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS :2698-2726 takes the ELSE this time rather than case01's CDEMO-PGM-ENTER CONTINUE: :2703-2704 requires CC-ACCT-ID-N = 0 AND FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID and the filter is blank, so :2707 MOVEs CC-ACCT-ID - still LOW-VALUES from :1053 - into ACCTSIDO, and the EVALUATE at :2710-2712 matches ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and performs 3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES :2731-2785, which MOVEs LOW-VALUES into all forty-seven data items explicitly. So the forty-seven data fields are x'00' by two independent routes and the five monetary items ACRDLIMO, ACSHLIMO, ACURBALO, ACRCYCRO and ACRCYDBO are x'00' rather than an edited zero. FKEYSO, FKEY05O and FKEY12O are the mapset's own INITIAL text at app/bms/COACTUP.bms:493-507 and are never assigned by the program. THE ATTRIBUTE PLANES are the fifty-four xxxC colour items and fifty-four xxxH highlight items: every colour is DFHDFCOL except ACCTSIDC, and every highlight is DFHDFHI except INFOMSGH, which 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS :3567-3571 sets to DFHBMASB because WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is false - there is an information message. Its two companions do not fire: :3573-3576 needs ACUP-CHANGES-MADE and the change action is LOW-VALUES, and :3578-3581 needs PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION, an 88 on WS-INFO-MSG which now holds the search-key prompt, so FKEY05H and FKEY12H stay DFHDFHI. The xxxA items that 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS :3441-3494 and :2996 write - DFHBMPRF into fifty of them and DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA, making the filter the one writable field - are deliberately NOT declared: they are items of the INPUT redefine CACTUPAI, not of the sent CACTUPAO, and ScreenSend.attributes admits only output planes whose names end in C, P, H or V. DFHBMSCA publishes no mnemonic for a programmed-symbol or validation byte, so xxxP and xxxV are not named either. THE CURSOR is ACCTSIDL, and it arrives there by a different arm than case01's does not - both cases reach the same arm, but for a reason worth stating: the EVALUATE at :3009 is order-sensitive, FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA at :3010 is false because 3250 left WS-INFO-MSG holding the search-key prompt, NO-CHANGES-DETECTED at :3011 is false because WS-RETURN-MSG holds 'No input received' and not 'No change detected with respect to values fetched.' - a genuine near-miss, since both are 88s on the same field - and :3013-3015 then matches on FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK and MOVEs -1 TO ACCTSIDL. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, so the xxxL item IS the cursor; ACCTSIDL is named for that reason and is not a payload field. NAVIGATION AND STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37): every scrap of conversation state travels in the payload and none is held server-side. The WHEN OTHER arm assigns nothing to CARDDEMO-COMMAREA except the MOVE ZEROES to CDEMO-ACCT-ID at :1794, which is a no-op against the zeroes that arrived, and it does not touch CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, CDEMO-LAST-MAP or CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET - so the outbound navigation image is byte-identical to the inbound one, and the context that leaves is still REENTER. That equality is itself the assertion: a program that reset the context here would paint case01's screen on the next turn instead of this one's. :1030-1033 also MOVEs WS-RETURN-MSG to CCARD-ERROR-MSG and LIT-THISPGM, LIT-THISMAPSET and LIT-THISMAP into CCARD-NEXT-PROG, CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET and CCARD-NEXT-MAP, which is why nextProgram is COACTUPC here and absent from case01 - 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS is the only paragraph that assigns it and case01 never performs it. COMMON-RETURN :1007-1020 packs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA followed immediately by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA into WS-COMMAREA and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID) - Termination RETURN_TRANSID, never XCTL. NOTHING IS WRITTEN AND NOTHING IS READ. COACTUPC's file verbs are the reads at :3656 and :3705 and the read-for-update and rewrite pairs inside 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING, and this path reaches none of them because 2000-DECIDE-ACTION's shared block was skipped, so expectedWrites is empty as a POSITIVE assertion and each of the four seeded rows is pinned unchanged on the final-state channel as the other half of it. The rows are the same coherent slice case01 seeds, for ACCT-ID 00000000001: acctdata.txt row 0, custdata.txt row 0 (CUST-ID 000000001), and carddata.txt and cardxref.txt row 48, the cross-reference and card for that account. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is NOT pre-padded: CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER X(14), so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and the final-state image is asserted at the copybook's 50 (gate G16). Pre-padding the input would double-pad it. RETURN CODE 0. COACTUPC never sets a COBOL RETURN-CODE - the identifier does not occur anywhere in its 4,236 lines - because it is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. expectedMessages carries exactly one entry, on DISPLAY_LINE at WS-RETURN-MSG's declared PIC X(75), which is the channel and the width COACTUPCParityTest itself uses for this field. The information line gets no entry: MessageChannel publishes DISPLAY_LINE, WS_MESSAGE_80 and SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 and no 45-byte channel exists, so it is pinned byte-exactly where the program actually put it, in INFOMSGO at its declared 45, alongside ERRMSGO at its declared 78 - the same 17 characters as the message entry, two bytes wider. NO ARITHMETIC IS REACHED, so no scale and no rounding mode applies. Where COACTUPC does compute, ROUNDED appears zero times in it and in all twenty-eight programs, so a receiver's PIC S9(10)V99 scale of 2 is reached by truncation - RoundingMode.DOWN, never HALF_UP or HALF_EVEN - but no such value appears in this case. Every record image and every screen value here is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never the platform default (practice B8). TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE and are recorded as such rather than silently skipped. G32 does not apply: COACTUPC's fifty-one GO TOs all target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage - the two this case takes, :1061 and :3189, are both forward - and CBSTM03A is the only program in the migration whose GO TOs form implicit loops. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC - the nine sites are all in batch programs - and its only abnormal exit is the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') reached from ABEND-ROUTINE, which the HANDLE ABEND at :862-864 arms and which 2000-DECIDE-ACTION's WHEN OTHER at :2633-2640 could reach, but not from this arm. PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value above was derived STATICALLY, by structured reading of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:175-200, :463-490, :530-560, :652-668, :859-1033, :1039-1062, :1429-1449, :1783-1822, :2562-2645, :2649-2726, :2731-2785, :2955-2982, :2986-3016, :3120-3192, :3208-3436, :3441-3494 and :3566-3585, together with app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy in full, cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and INITIAL text of app/bms/COACTUP.bms, the commarea layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the titles in app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the CC-ACCT-ID and CC-ACCT-ID-N REDEFINES pair in app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, the date header in app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, the copybook byte layouts CVACT01Y 300 / CVCUS01Y 500 / CVACT02Y 150 / CVACT03Y 50, and the real fixtures in app/data/ASCII. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A rather than silently absorbed. THREE AUTHORING NOTES. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59, this source revision's own timestamp - every file carries 'Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:15:5x CDT', COTTL01Y.cpy:26 among them - so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals no wall clock can reach (practice B7), and the value is case01's so the two cases differ in behaviour and not in incidentals. The payload items are keyed by their symbolic OUTPUT names because a sent map carries CACTUPAO and ScreenSend.fields admits only xxxO items; the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA metadata items appear nowhere in this file except ACCTSIDL as the cursor, which is where COBOL expresses a cursor. And COACTUPCParityTest currently declares its twenty scenarios in Java rather than loading them from this directory, allocating case02 to an AccountUpdateService concurrency check; the divergence in NUMBERING is recorded here rather than resolved by inventing a different scenario, because the scenario itself - unit kind CONTROLLER_POJO, AccountUpdateController constructed directly and its handler called as a plain method with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path (gate G51) - is what this case is specified to pin.

OBSERVATION SCOPE, STATED SO IT CANNOT BE MISREAD AS AN OMISSION. COACTUPC contains no DISPLAY verb - no CICS program does - so this case declares no DISPLAY_LINE and no SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 message. WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :479 leaves the program through MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO OF CACTUPAO at :2981 followed by EXEC CICS SEND MAP, and ERRMSGO is pinned byte for byte inside expectedResponse.sends at its declared PIC X(78) width. Declaring it a second time on a message channel would make one difference report as two and would invent an emission the program does not perform. The eighty-byte WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT of each CALL 'CSUTLDTC' (app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy:293 into app/cpy/CSUTLDWY.cpy:60-85) IS declared, on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel and in call order, because nothing in the response exposes it and its count is itself an assertion about how far the edit chain ran.

fields.INFOMSGO: Enter or update id of account to update
